name: Markdown to HTML Converter
description: Convert Markdown to HTML instantly with a live preview — headings, formatting, lists, links, images, code blocks, and blockquotes, safely escaped against raw HTML injection.

faq.question: Is it safe to paste Markdown from an untrusted source?
faq.answer: Yes — every character of your input is HTML-escaped before any Markdown syntax is turned into a real tag, so a stray <script> tag or an HTML event-handler attribute always ends up as inert, visible text rather than executable markup. Link and image URLs additionally reject the javascript: scheme.

faq.question: What Markdown features aren't supported?
faq.answer: Tables, nested lists or blockquotes, footnotes, and reference-style links ([text][id] with a separate definition line) aren't implemented — this covers the common subset most everyday writing actually uses (headings, bold/italic, inline code, fenced code blocks, links, images, single-level lists and blockquotes, horizontal rules, hard line breaks), not the complete CommonMark specification.
